ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - XORDump Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious use of XORDump process memory dumping utility

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\xordump\\\.exe$") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-process\\ lsass\\\.exe\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m\\ comsvcs\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m\\ dbghelp\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m\\ dbgcore\\ .*")))
